user.title: VTherm inhibition
user.description: Select the Versatile Thermostat that must step back while another device takes over.

data.stop_underlyings: Turn the devices off when the inhibition starts

data_description.source_entities: Binary sensors, input booleans and switches inhibit when on; climate entities when in one of the modes below. Any active source inhibits.
data_description.climate_hvac_modes: A climate source inhibits while its HVAC mode is one of these.
data_description.activation_delay: Seconds a source must stay active before the VTherm steps back.
data_description.deactivation_delay: Seconds all sources must stay inactive before the VTherm resumes.
data_description.unavailable_grace_period: Seconds the last status is kept while a source is unavailable before it becomes unknown.
data_description.stop_underlyings: On: the VTherm turns its devices off once when it steps back. Off: it steps back without sending anything, the devices are left as they are. A change applies from the next inhibition.

error.not_a_vtherm: This entity is not a Versatile Thermostat.
error.source_is_target: The VTherm cannot be its own source.
error.source_feeds_back: A source cannot be the VTherm, a device it controls or an inhibition entity.

abort.already_configured: This VTherm already has an inhibition entry.

core_without_inhibition.title: Versatile Thermostat without inhibition support
core_without_inhibition.description: VTherm Inhibition needs the first Versatile Thermostat release that includes inhibition (#2087) and vtherm_api 0.6.1 or later. The installed Versatile Thermostat refused the inhibition request. Update Versatile Thermostat, then restart Home Assistant.

missing_sources.title: Missing inhibition sources
missing_sources.description: The inhibition of {entry} uses sources that do not exist any more: {sources}. While a source is missing the status becomes unknown after the grace period. Edit the options of the entry to choose other sources.

unset_failing.title: Versatile Thermostat cannot leave the inhibition
unset_failing.description: The inhibition of {entry} is over, but {vtherm} could not leave it: {error}. The VTherm stays inhibited (devices not controlled). The plugin keeps retrying every 5 minutes; check the Versatile Thermostat logs. This issue disappears once the VTherm has resumed or the inhibition is active again.
